complaints.description: The administration is collecting mandatory development and laboratory fees far above the state fee regulatory committee ceiling without issuing an official receipt. Ref dossier 35-4.

complaints.title: Bullying and retaliatory grading against grievance petitioners (Batch 2025 Sec B)
complaints.description: Students who signed a petition regarding hostel welfare were threatened with low internal evaluation marks and disciplinary bullying. Ref dossier 35-5.

complaints.title: Original documents and degree marksheet withheld by registrar (Batch 2023 Sec C)
complaints.description: The registrar office has withheld my original 10th and 12th marksheet and transfer certificate, demanding full four-year fees before releasing my documents. Ref dossier 35-6.

complaints.title: Irregular management quota seats filled without merit counselling (Batch 2024 Sec D)
complaints.description: Seats reserved for state counselling were converted into management quota seats with undisclosed capitation charges before the final counselling round. Ref dossier 35-7.

complaints.title: Delay in revaluation results for backlog examination papers (Batch 2023 Sec A)
complaints.description: Students who applied for exam answer-script revaluation two months ago have still not received updated results. Ref dossier 36-0.

complaints.title: Misleading advertisement claiming 100% placement and fake ranking (Batch 2024 Sec B)
complaints.description: The college published full-page newspaper advertisements with a fake ranking and false claim of 100% placement with inflated international salary packages. Ref dossier 36-1.

complaints.title: Security deposit and tuition refund delayed after seat cancellation (Batch 2025 Sec C)
complaints.description: After cancelling my seat before the semester started, the college promised to process my tuition fee refund and caution deposit within fifteen days, but no refund has been received. Ref dossier 36-2.

complaints.title: Campus environment unsafe for girls due to broken perimeter lighting (Batch 2023 Sec D)
complaints.description: Pathways between the central library and the women hostel have no lighting or security guards after 7 PM, making the campus unsafe for girls. Ref dossier 36-3.

complaints.title: Delay in issuing bonafide certificate for education loan renewal (Batch 2024 Sec A)
complaints.description: The administrative cell has delayed issuing bonafide and fee structure certificates for over five weeks, stalling bank education loan disbursements. Ref dossier 36-4.

complaints.title: Admission granted in excess of AICTE approved intake capacity (Batch 2025 Sec B)
complaints.description: The institution admitted 45 extra students in the Computer Science branch beyond the sanctioned AICTE intake quota without extension of approval. Ref dossier 36-5.

complaints.title: Fire safety equipment expired and emergency exits locked in academic block (Batch 2023 Sec C)
complaints.description: Fire extinguishers across the four-storey laboratory building expired two years ago and the secondary staircase is permanently padlocked. Ref dossier 36-6.

complaints.title: Ghost faculty listed on muster rolls for AICTE inspection compliance (Batch 2024 Sec D)
complaints.description: Several professors listed on the institutional website and compliance portal are ghost faculty who never teach classes on campus. Ref dossier 36-7.

complaints.title: Tuition fee refund not returned after withdrawing admission (Batch 2023 Sec A)
complaints.description: I withdrew my admission within the AICTE stipulated counselling window, yet the accounts office has withheld my tuition fee refund and original receipt for over six weeks despite three written reminders. Ref dossier 37-0.

complaints.title: Mental harassment and discriminatory rules by hostel warden (Batch 2024 Sec B)
complaints.description: Students raising grievances about mess hygiene face targeted mental harassment, arbitrary fines, and intimidation from the chief hostel warden. Ref dossier 37-1.

complaints.title: Migration certificate withheld despite clearing all library and hostel dues (Batch 2025 Sec C)
complaints.description: Even after submitting the signed no-dues form, the student section refuses to issue the migration certificate and original documents. Ref dossier 37-2.

complaints.title: Misleading seat capacity declared during state admission counselling (Batch 2023 Sec D)
complaints.description: The college reported full laboratory readiness to secure higher seat intake approval while lacking basic instructional space for admitted batches. Ref dossier 37-3.

complaints.title: Critical electrical hazard and exposed wiring in high-voltage machine lab (Batch 2024 Sec A)
complaints.description: The electrical machines laboratory has exposed live distribution panels, water seepage near switchgear, and missing circuit breakers, creating a severe electrical hazard and fire risk. Ref dossier 37-4.

complaints.title: Faculty salary unpaid for four consecutive months across departments (Batch 2025 Sec B)
complaints.description: Regular teaching faculty and laboratory staff have had their salary unpaid since the start of the semester, leading to mass resignations and halted classes. Ref dossier 37-5.

complaints.title: Practical laboratory sessions cancelled throughout the academic timetable (Batch 2023 Sec C)
complaints.description: Scheduled laboratory sessions on the timetable were repeatedly cancelled due to broken equipment, affecting practical evaluation. Ref dossier 37-6.

complaints.title: Provisional degree certificate and transcript delayed by four months (Batch 2023 Sec A)
complaints.description: Graduating batch students have not received their provisional degree certificate or official transcript, causing multiple students to lose postgraduate admission offers. Ref dossier 38-0.

complaints.title: Course running without valid AICTE affiliation and approval renewal (Batch 2024 Sec B)
complaints.description: A new specialization track in Artificial Intelligence is admitting students even though the extension of approval letter does not list this programme. Ref dossier 38-1.

complaints.title: Structural cracks and ceiling plaster collapse in third-floor classroom (Batch 2025 Sec C)
complaints.description: Large portions of ceiling plaster collapsed during a lecture in Room 304; the building wing shows visible structural dampness and unsafe wiring. Ref dossier 38-2.

complaints.title: Severe faculty vacancies and no faculty for core third-year subjects (Batch 2023 Sec D)
complaints.description: More than half of the sanctioned associate professor posts are vacant, leaving third-year engineering batches with no faculty for three core subjects this semester. Ref dossier 38-3.

complaints.title: Arbitrary internal attendance mismatch and delayed exam results (Batch 2024 Sec A)
complaints.description: Published attendance records contain widespread mismatch errors and internal evaluation results have been delayed without explanation. Ref dossier 38-4.

complaints.title: Brochure misrepresents tie-ups with global technology recruiters (Batch 2025 Sec B)
complaints.description: The admission brochure makes a misleading claim of guaranteed corporate internships and false package statistics to attract applicants. Ref dossier 38-5.

complaints.title: Scholarship money and tuition deposit withheld by accounts section (Batch 2023 Sec C)
complaints.description: State scholarship money credited to the institution has not been adjusted against our semester fee, and students are being threatened with exam debarment. Ref dossier 38-6.

complaints.title: Severe sanitation failure and unsafe drinking water in student hostel (Batch 2023 Sec A)
complaints.description: Water purifiers in the main academic building and hostel have been non-functional for a month, and sanitation conditions in washrooms are hazardous. Ref dossier 39-0.

complaints.title: Unqualified visiting staff assigned to teach final-year laboratory courses (Batch 2024 Sec B)
